_comment: The fakes the battery jobs run, hosted by ONE launcher process, each still
on its own port. Replaces eleven near-identical start steps in
.github/actions/integ-battery-setup/action.yml, each of which spawned a
node process and polled its own log file.
EVERY port is pinned, and to the same number the eleven steps used, so the
only thing that changes is how many processes serve them. Do not 'simplify'
these to 0. An ephemeral port comes from 49152-65535, which is also the
range a client draws its SOURCE port from, and this suite opens tens of
thousands of short-lived connections: with the listeners inside that range
the runs fail with EADDRNOTAVAIL ('Can't assign requested address'), and
they fail NON-deterministically -- observed as an abort, then 62 failures,
then 7, then none, on the same command. Pinned low ports sit outside the
range and the same run is 19170/0 three times over.
Two of these are pinned for a second reason, which matters if anyone ever
does want to move them:
hf-hub 5086  Nine corpus goldens in integ/cli/hf.json contain the URL
verbatim, because the hf CLI prints it.
mail   5085  The battery jobs set MAIL_URL in their job-level env:, and a
job-level env wins over anything a step writes to GITHUB_ENV.
mail   imap 3143 / smtp 3025
Both runner adapters read EMAIL_IMAP_PORT with these as the
DEFAULT and never read the announced MAIL_IMAP_URL.
